Frequently asked questions

What does an AMC cover?

Preventive visits, on-site and remote support for the systems listed in your contract — IT, CCTV, networks, POS or automation.

Can one contract cover several systems?

Yes. You can combine IT, CCTV, network, POS and automation in one AMC.

Do you maintain systems installed by others?

Yes, after an initial inspection to check their condition.
